prompt_hint: Order: style, subject, motion, scene, then camera and light (shot size, angle, soft or hard light).
Text to video: about 60-200 characters. With a start image: under 100, and describe only motion and camera.
Do not repeat what the start image already shows. Write 'fixed shot' for a still camera.
One shot per clip, no sound or speech. Put unwanted things in Negative prompt, not the prompt.
